bucket.description: Customer bucket. If specified, your GCS bucket will be used to process the data instead of a Fivetran-managed bucket. The bucket must be present in the same location as the dataset location.

data_set_location.description: Data location. Datasets will reside in this location.

secret_key.description: Private key of the customer service account. If specified, your service account will be used to process the data instead of the Fivetran-managed service account.

support_json_type.description: Stores JSON columns as JSON instead of STRING. This parameter is applicable only to destinations created before August 1, 2025.
